`l`.`lkategoripos` = `pi`.`pikategori` and `i`.`bid` = `pi`.`piidbarang` left join `m1_item_permission` `tag` ON `i`.`btag` = `tag`.`ipkode` left join m1_item_stock_warehouse isw ON i.bid = isw.idbarang AND u.ugudang = isw.kgudang left join `m1_item_booking` `ib` on `i`.`bid` = `ib`.`idbarang` left join `m1_contact` `c` on `i`.`bsuplier` = `c`.`kid` left join `m1_files` `f` on `f`.`fsumber` = 'Item' and `i`.`bid` = `f`.`fidtransaksi` and `f`.`fdefault` = 1

AS `kkategoricustomer`,`custc`.`ccnama` AS `kkategoricustomernama`,`c`.`kkategorisupplier` AS `kkategorisupplier`,`suppc`.`scnama` AS `kkategorisuppliernama`,`c`.`ksalesman` AS `ksalesman`,`cs`.`knama` AS `ksalesmannama`,`ca`.`kanama` AS `kkontakperson`,`c`.`kaktif` AS `kaktif`,`c`.`k1alamat1` AS `k1alamat1`,`c`.`k1alamat2` AS `k1alamat2`,`c`.`k1kota` AS `k1kota`,`c`.`k1propinsi` AS `k1propinsi`,`c`.`k1kodepos` AS `k1kodepos`,`c`.`k1negara` AS `k1negara`,`c`.`k1kontakperson` AS `k1kontakperson`,`c`.`k1notelp1` AS `k1notelp1`,`c`.`k2alamat1` AS `k2alamat1`,`c`.`k2alamat2` AS `k2alamat2`,`c`.`k2propinsi` AS `k2propinsi`,`c`.`k2kota` AS `k2kota`,`c`.`k2kodepos` AS `k2kodepos`,`c`.`k2negara` AS `k2negara`,`c`.`k2kontakperson` AS `k2kontakperson`,`c`.`k2notelp1` AS `k2notelp1`,`c`.`kterminbeli` AS `kterminbeli`,`c`.`kterminjual` AS `kterminjual`,`c`.`ktingkatjual` AS `ktingkatjual`,`c`.`kkomisipenjualan` AS `kkomisipenjualan`,`cs`.`kkode` AS `ksalesmankode` from ((((((((`m1_contact` `c` join `m0_user` `u` on(((`u`.`userid` = 'valuserid') and ((`c`.`klokasi` = '') or (`c`.`klokasi` = `u`.`ulokasi`))))) left join `m1_contact` `cs` on((`c`.`ksalesman` = `cs`.`kid`))) left join `m1_contact_attention` `ca` on(((`c`.`kid` = `ca`.`kaidkontak`) and (`ca`.`kadefault` = 1)))) left join `m1_area` `a` on((`c`.`karea` = `a`.`akode`))) left join `m1_contact_category` `cc` on((`c`.`kkategori` = `cc`.`cckode`))) left join `m1_salesman_category` `sc` on((`c`.`kkategorisalesman` = `sc`.`sckode`))) left join `m1_customer_category` `custc` on((`c`.`kkategoricustomer` = `custc`.`cckode`))) left join `m1_supplier_category` `suppc` on((`c`.`kkategorisupplier` = `suppc`.`sckode`)))
```

```sql
SELECT c.kid AS kid, c.kkode AS kkode, c.knama AS knama, c.kkategori AS kkategori, cc.ccnama AS kkategorinama, c.kcabang AS kcabang, c.klokasi AS klokasi, c.kgudang AS kgudang, c.kkategorisalesman AS kkategorisalesman, sc.scnama AS kkategorisalesmannama, c.karea AS karea, a.anama AS kareanama, c.kkategoricustomer AS kkategoricustomer, custc.ccnama AS kkategoricustomernama, c.kkategorisupplier AS kkategorisupplier, suppc.scnama AS kkategorisuppliernama, c.ksalesman AS ksalesman, cs.knama AS ksalesmannama, ca.kanama AS kkontakperson, c.kaktif AS kaktif, c.k1alamat1 AS k1alamat1, c.k1alamat2 AS k1alamat2, c.k1kota AS k1kota, c.k1propinsi AS k1propinsi, c.k1kodepos AS k1kodepos, c.k1negara AS k1negara, c.k1kontakperson AS k1kontakperson, c.k1notelp1 AS k1notelp1, c.k2alamat1 AS k2alamat1, c.k2alamat2 AS k2alamat2, c.k2propinsi AS k2propinsi, c.k2kota AS k2kota, c.k2kodepos AS k2kodepos, c.k2negara AS k2negara, c.k2kontakperson AS k2kontakperson, c.k2notelp1 AS k2notelp1, c.kterminbeli AS kterminbeli, c.kterminjual AS kterminjual, c.ktingkatjual AS ktingkatjual, c.kkomisipenjualan AS kkomisipenjualan, cs.kkode AS ksalesmankode, cp.cppoin, c.kpkp AS kpkp from `m1_contact` `c` join `m0_user` `u` on `u`.`userid` = 'valuserid' and (`c`.`klokasi` = '' or `c`.`klokasi` = `u`.`ulokasi`) left join `m1_contact` `cs` on `c`.`ksalesman` = `cs`.`kid` left join `m1_contact_attention` `ca` on `c`.`kid` = `ca`.`kaidkontak` and `ca`.`kadefault` = 1 left join `m1_area` `a` on `c`.`karea` = `a`.`akode` left join `m1_contact_category` `cc` on `c`.`kkategori` = `cc`.`cckode` left join `m1_salesman_category` `sc` on `c`.`kkategorisalesman` = `sc`.`sckode` left join `m1_customer_category` `custc` on `c`.`kkategoricustomer` = `custc`.`cckode` left join `m1_supplier_category` `suppc` on `c`.`kkategorisupplier` = `suppc`.`sckode` left join m1_contact_point cp ON c.kid = cp.cpidkontak
```

kkategorisalesman, sc.scnama AS kkategorisalesmannama, c.karea AS karea, a.anama AS kareanama, c.kkategoricustomer AS kkategoricustomer, custc.ccnama AS kkategoricustomernama, c.kkategorisupplier AS kkategorisupplier, suppc.scnama AS kkategorisuppliernama, c.ksalesman AS ksalesman, cs.knama AS ksalesmannama, ca.kanama AS kkontakperson, c.kaktif AS kaktif, c.k1alamat1 AS k1alamat1, c.k1alamat2 AS dccnilai from `m1_contact` `c` join `m0_user` `u` on `u`.`userid` = 'valuserid' and (`c`.`klokasi` = '' or `c`.`klokasi` = `u`.`ulokasi`) left join `m1_contact` `cs` on `c`.`ksalesman` = `cs`.`kid` left join `m1_contact_attention` `ca` on `c`.`kid` = `ca`.`kaidkontak` and `ca`.`kadefault` = 1 left join `m1_area` `a` on `c`.`karea` = `a`.`akode` left join `m1_contact_category` `cc` on `c`.`kkategori` = `cc`.`cckode` left join `m1_salesman_category` `sc` on `c`.`kkategorisalesman` = `sc`.`sckode` left join `m1_customer_category` `custc` on `c`.`kkategoricustomer` = `custc`.`cckode` left join `m1_supplier_category` `suppc` on `c`.`kkategorisupplier` = `suppc`.`sckode` left join m1_contact_point cp ON c.kid = cp.cpidkontak left join m1_location l on u.ulokasi = l.lkode left join m_12_pos_discount_category_customer dcc on l.lkategoripos = dcc.dcckategori and c.kkategoricustomer = dcc.dcckategoricustomer

urutan, ppad.statusberlaku AS statusberlaku, ppad.isclose AS isclose, ppad.customtext1 AS customtext1, ppad.customtext2 AS customtext2, ppad.customtext3 AS customtext3, ppad.customdbl1 AS customdbl1, namabarang, i.btipe AS tipebarang, brd.bnama AS cabangnama, lcd.lnama AS lokasinama, whd.wnama AS gudangnama, cc.ccnama AS costcenternama, d.dnama AS divisinama, sd.sdnama AS subdivisinama, p.pnama AS proyeknama, ppad.stokminimallama AS stokminimallama, ppad.stokmaksimallama AS stokmaksimallama, ppad.stokreorderlama AS stokreorderlama, ppad.stokminorderlama AS stokminorderlama, ppad.stokminimal AS stokminimal, ppad.stokmaksimal AS stokmaksimal, ppad.stokreorder AS stokreorder, ppad.stokminorder AS stokminorder, ppad.hargabeli AS hargabeli, ppad.margin1 AS margin1, ppad.margin2 AS margin2, from m_12_ppa ppa join m_12_ppa_detail ppad on ppa.ppaid = ppad.idppa join m0_status st1 on st1.kode = ppa.ppastatus join m0_status st2 on st2.kode = ppa.ppastatussebelumnya left join m1_branch br on br.bkode = ppa.ppacabang left join m1_location lc on lc.lkode = ppa.ppalokasi left join m1_warehouse wh on wh.wkode = ppa.ppagudang left join m1_contact c1 on c1.kid = ppa.ppabagianppa left join m0_user u1 on u1.userid = ppa.ppainputuser left join m0_user u2 on u2.userid = ppa.ppamodifikasiuser left join m_12_pos_category pc on ppa.ppakategoripos = pc.pckode left join m1_item i on m1_cost_center cc on ppad.costcenter = cc.cckode left join m1_division d on ppad.divisi = d.dkode left join m1_subdivision sd on ppad.subdivisi = sd.sdkode left join m1_project p on ppad.proyek = p.pkode

```sql
select `mn`.`mnmoduleid` AS `mnmoduleid`,`mn`.`mnid` AS `mnid`,`mn`.`mnname` AS `mnname`,`mn`.`mnnameind` AS `mnnameind`,`mn`.`mnurl` AS `mnurl`,`mn`.`mnparent` AS `mnparent`,`mn`.`mntype` AS `mntype`,`mn`.`mnlevel` AS `mnlevel`,`mn`.`mnurutan` AS `mnurutan`,`mn`.`mnactive` AS `mnactive`,`mn`.`mnviewopening` AS `mnviewopening`,`mn`.`mnpopup` AS `mnpopup`,`mn`.`mnlebar` AS `mnlebar`,`mn`.`mntinggi` AS `mntinggi`,`u`.`userid` AS `userid`,u.ubahasa as ubahasa, `rm`.`rmakses` AS `rmakses`,`rm`.`rmfavourite` AS `rmfavourite` from (((`m0_user` `u` join `m0_user_role` `ur` on((`u`.`userid` = `ur`.`userid`))) join `m0_role_menu` `rm` on((`ur`.`role` = `rm`.`rmrole`))) join `m0_menu` `mn` on(((`mn`.`mnmoduleid` = `rm`.`rmmoduleid`) and (`rm`.`rmmenuid` = `mn`.`mnid`))))
```

```sql
select `mn`.`mnmoduleid` AS `mnmoduleid`,`mn`.`mnid` AS `mnid`,`mn`.`mnname` AS `mnname`,`mnl`.`mnltranslate` AS `mnltranslate`,`mn`.`mnurl` AS `mnurl`,`mn`.`mnparent` AS `mnparent`,`mn`.`mntype` AS `mntype`,`mn`.`mnlevel` AS `mnlevel`,`mn`.`mnurutan` AS `mnurutan`,`mn`.`mnactive` AS `mnactive`,`mn`.`mnviewopening` AS `mnviewopening`,`mn`.`mnpopup` AS `mnpopup`,`mn`.`mnlebar` AS `mnlebar`,`mn`.`mntinggi` AS `mntinggi`,`mn`.`mnidtransaksi` AS `mnidtransaksi`,`u`.`userid` AS `userid`,`u`.`ubahasa` AS `ubahasa`,`rm`.`rmakses` AS `rmakses`,`rm`.`rmfavourite` AS `rmfavourite` from ((((`m0_user` `u` join `m0_user_role` `ur` on((`u`.`userid` = `ur`.`userid`))) join `m0_role_menu` `rm` on((convert(`ur`.`role` using utf8) = convert(`rm`.`rmrole` using utf8)))) join `m0_menu` `mn` on(((`mn`.`mnmoduleid` = `rm`.`rmmoduleid`) and (`rm`.`rmmenuid` = `mn`.`mnid`)))) left join `m0_menu_lang` `mnl` on(((`mn`.`mnmoduleid` = `mnl`.`mnlmoduleid`) and (`mn`.`mnid` = `mnl`.`mnlmnid`) and (`u`.`ubahasa` = `mnl`.`mnllanguage`))))
```

select `mn`.`mnmoduleid` AS `mnmoduleid`,`mn`.`mnid` AS `mnid`,`mn`.`mnname` AS `mnname`,`mnl`.`mnltranslate` AS `mnltranslate`,`mn`.`mnurl` AS `mnurl`,`mn`.`mntype` AS `mntype`,`mn`.`mnpopup` AS `mnpopup`,`mn`.`mnlebar` AS `mnlebar`,`mn`.`mntinggi` AS `mntinggi`,`mn`.`mnidtransaksi` AS `mnidtransaksi`,'1111111111111' AS `rmakses` from (`m0_menu` `mn` left join `m0_menu_lang` `mnl` on(((`mn`.`mnmoduleid` = `mnl`.`mnlmoduleid`) and (`mn`.`mnid` = `mnl`.`mnlmnid`) and (`mnl`.`mnllanguage` = 'valbahasa'))))
```

SELECT sad.idsadetail, sad.idbarang, i.bkode as kodebarang, sad.namabarang, sad.tipebarang, sad.satuan, sad.nilaisatuan, sad.satuanbarang, (CASE j.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN isw.stok / sad.nilaisatuan ELSE 0 END) as jmlmasuk, (CASE j.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN isw.stok / sad.nilaisatuan ELSE 0 END) as jmlkeluar, (CASE j.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN isw.stok ELSE 0 END) as jmlbarangmasuk, (CASE j.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN isw.stok ELSE 0 END) as jmlbarangkeluar, sad.hpp, sad.idhppkhususmasuk, isw.kgudang as gudang, sad.urutan, sad.catatan, sad.costcenter, sad.divisi, sad.subdivisi, sad.customdbl1, sad.proyek, sa.sainputtgl, i.bhpp, i.bjenis FROM m3_sa_detail sad JOIN m3_sa sa ON sad.idsa = sa.said JOIN m1_item i ON sad.idbarang = i.bid JOIN m0_jenismutasi j JOIN m1_item_stock_warehouse isw ON sad.idbarang = isw.idbarang AND isw.stok <> 0 WHERE (sa.sastatus = 2 OR sa.sastatus = 3 OR sa.sastatus = 4 OR sa.sastatus = 7) AND sa.said = '{idtransaksi}' ORDER BY sad.urutan, j.jenismutasi, isw.kgudang, sad.idsadetail

## `client-backend/api-myerpplus/app_code/ws/m0/m0_query.vb`

```sql
select `u`.`userid` AS `userid`,`u`.`ukode` AS `ukode`,`u`.`unama` AS `unama`,`u`.`upassword` AS `upassword`,`u`.`ukontak` AS `ukontak`,ifnull(`c`.`kkode`,'') AS `ukontakkode`,ifnull(`c`.`knama`,'') AS `ukontaknama`,`u`.`ucabang` AS `ucabang`,ifnull(`b`.`bnama`,'') AS `ucabangnama`,`u`.`ulokasi` AS `ulokasi`,ifnull(`l`.`lnama`,'') AS `ulokasinama`,`u`.`ugudang` AS `ugudang`,ifnull(`w`.`wnama`,'') AS `ugudangnama`,`u`.`ukota` AS `ukota`,`u`.`ugambar` AS `ugambar`,`u`.`uaktif` AS `uaktif`,`u`.`utglexpired` AS `utglexpired`,`u`.`ulevel` AS `ulevel`,`u`.`ugrup` AS `ugrup`,ifnull(`ug`.`ugnama`,'') AS `ugrupnama`,`u`.`ubahasa` AS `ubahasa`,`u`.`udefaultview` AS `udefaultview`,`lg`.`lnama` AS `ubahasanama`,`ct`.`cnama` AS `ukotanama`,`ca`.`kanama` AS `kontakperson`,`ca`.`kaalamat` AS `kontakpersonalamat` from ((((((((`m0_user` `u` left join `m1_contact` `c` on((`u`.`ukontak` = `c`.`kid`))) left join `m1_branch` `b` on((`u`.`ucabang` = `b`.`bkode`))) left join `m1_location` `l` on((`u`.`ulokasi` = `l`.`lkode`))) left join `m1_warehouse` `w` on((`u`.`ugudang` = `w`.`wkode`))) left join `m0_usergrup` `ug` on((`u`.`ugrup` = `ug`.`ugkode`))) left join `m0_language` `lg` on((`u`.`ubahasa` = `lg`.`lkode`))) left join `m1_city` `ct` on((`u`.`ukota` = `ct`.`ckode`))) left join `m1_contact_attention` `ca` on(((`c`.`kid` = `ca`.`kaidkontak`) and (`ca`.`kadefault` = 1))))
```

```sql
select `u`.`userid` AS `userid`,`u`.`ukode` AS `ukode`,`u`.`unama` AS `unama`,`u`.`upassword` AS `upassword`,`u`.`ukontak` AS `ukontak`,`u`.`ucabang` AS `ucabang`,`u`.`ulokasi` AS `ulokasi`,`u`.`ugudang` AS `ugudang`,`u`.`ukota` AS `ukota`,`u`.`ugambar` AS `ugambar`,`u`.`uaktif` AS `uaktif`,`u`.`utglexpired` AS `utglexpired`,`u`.`ulevel` AS `ulevel`,`u`.`ugrup` AS `ugrup`,`u`.`ubahasa` AS `ubahasa`,`u`.`udefaultview` AS `udefaultview`,`c`.`kkode` AS `ukontakkode`,`c`.`knama` AS `ukontaknama`,`br`.`bnama` AS `ucabangnama`,`lc`.`lnama` AS `ulokasinama`,`wh`.`wnama` AS `ugudangnama`,`l`.`lnama` AS `ubahasanama`,`ur`.`userid` AS `uruserid`,`ur`.`role` AS `role`,`r`.`rnama` AS `rolenama` from (((((((`m0_user` `u` left join `m0_user_role` `ur` on((`u`.`userid` = `ur`.`userid`))) left join `m1_contact` `c` on((`u`.`ukontak` = `c`.`kid`))) left join `m1_branch` `br` on((`u`.`ucabang` = `br`.`bkode`))) left join `m1_location` `lc` on((`u`.`ulokasi` = `lc`.`lkode`))) left join `m1_warehouse` `wh` on((`u`.`ugudang` = `wh`.`wkode`))) left join `m0_language` `l` on((`u`.`ubahasa` = `l`.`lkode`))) left join `m0_role` `r` on((`ur`.`role` = `r`.`rkode`)))
```

```sql
select distinct `m0_usermenu`.`ummoduleid` AS `ummoduleid`,`m0_usermenu`.`umuserid` AS `umuserid`,`m0_module`.`mid` AS `mid`,`m0_module`.`mname` AS `mname`,`m0_module`.`mversion` AS `mversion`,`m0_module`.`mcompany` AS `mcompany`,`m0_module`.`mauthor` AS `mauthor`,`m0_module`.`mdescription` AS `mdescription`,`m0_module`.`mactive` AS `mactive`,`m0_module`.`murutan` AS `murutan` from (`m0_usermenu` join `m0_module` on((`m0_usermenu`.`ummoduleid` = `m0_module`.`mid`)))
```

```sql
select distinct `m`.`mid` AS `mid`,`u`.`userid` AS `userid`,`m`.`mname` AS `mname`,`m`.`mversion` AS `mversion`,`m`.`mcompany` AS `mcompany`,`m`.`mauthor` AS `mauthor`,`m`.`mdescription` AS `mdescription`,`m`.`mactive` AS `mactive`,`m`.`murutan` AS `murutan` from (((`m0_user` `u` join `m0_user_role` `ur` on((`u`.`userid` = `ur`.`userid`))) join `m0_role_menu` `rm` on((`ur`.`role` = `rm`.`rmrole`))) join `m0_module` `m` on((`rm`.`rmmoduleid` = `m`.`mid`)))
```

```sql
select `m0_menu`.`mnmoduleid` AS `mnmoduleid`,`m0_menu`.`mnid` AS `mnid`,`m0_menu`.`mnname` AS `mnname`,`m0_menu`.`mnnameind` AS `mnnameind`,`m0_menu`.`mnurl` AS `mnurl`,`m0_menu`.`mnparent` AS `mnparent`,`m0_menu`.`mntype` AS `mntype`,`m0_menu`.`mnlevel` AS `mnlevel`,`m0_menu`.`mnurutan` AS `mnurutan`,`m0_menu`.`mnactive` AS `mnactive`,`m0_menu`.`mnviewopening` AS `mnviewopening`,`m0_menu`.`mnpopup` AS `mnpopup`,`m0_menu`.`mnlebar` AS `mnlebar`,`m0_menu`.`mntinggi` AS `mntinggi`,`m0_usermenu`.`ummoduleid` AS `ummoduleid`,`m0_usermenu`.`ummenuid` AS `ummenuid`,`m0_usermenu`.`umuserid` AS `umuserid`,`u`.`ubahasa` AS `ubahasa`,`m0_usermenu`.`umakses` AS `umakses`,`m0_usermenu`.`umfavorite` AS `umfavorite` from ((`m0_menu` left join `m0_usermenu` on(((`m0_usermenu`.`ummenuid` = `m0_menu`.`mnid`) and (`m0_usermenu`.`ummoduleid` = `m0_menu`.`mnmoduleid`)))) join `m0_user` `u` on((`m0_usermenu`.`umuserid` = `u`.`userid`)))

`m1_bank` `b` on `c1`.`kbank` = `b`.`bkode` left join `m1_contact_attention` `ca` on `c1`.`kid` = `ca`.`kaidkontak` left join `m1_contact_category` `cc` on `c1`.`kkategori` = `cc`.`cckode` left join `m1_branch` `br` on `c1`.`kcabang` = `br`.`bkode` left join `m1_location` `l` on `c1`.`klokasi` = `l`.`lkode` left join `m1_warehouse` `w` on `c1`.`kgudang` = `w`.`wkode` left join `m1_salesman_category` `sc` on `c1`.`kkategorisalesman` = `sc`.`sckode` left join `m1_area` `a` on `c1`.`karea` = `a`.`akode` left join `m1_customer_category` `cusc` on `c1`.`kkategoricustomer` = `cusc`.`cckode` left join `m1_supplier_category` `suppc` on `c1`.`kkategorisupplier` = `suppc`.`sckode` left join `m1_division` `d` on `c1`.`kdivisi` = `d`.`dkode` left join `m1_subdivision` `sd` on `c1`.`ksubdivisi` = `sd`.`sdkode` left join `m0_selling_rate` `sr` on `c1`.`ktingkatjual` = `sr`.`kode` left join m1_commission comm on c1.kkomisikode = comm.kmkode

```sql
SELECT co.cid cid, co.cnomor cnomor, co.cnama cnama, co.cmatauang cmatauang, (CASE co.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN SUM(tj.tdebit) - SUM(tj.tkredit) ELSE SUM(tj.tkredit) - SUM(tj.tdebit) END) as csaldo, (CASE co.cmatauang WHEN s.snilai THEN 0 ELSE (CASE co.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN SUM(tj.tdebitvalas) - SUM(tj.tkreditvalas) ELSE SUM(tj.tkreditvalas) - SUM(tj.tdebitvalas) END) END) as csaldovalas FROM m1_coa co JOIN m2_transaction_journal tj ON co.cnomor = tj.tnorek JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'accounting' AND skode = 'MataUangFungsional'
```

```sql

```

```sql
SELECT t.tkontak, c.kkode as tkontakkode, c.knama as tkontaknama, s2.snilai as tmatauang, IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit), 0) - IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit), 0) as tsaldo, t.tnorek as tnorek FROM m2_transaction_journal t JOIN m1_contact c ON t.tkontak = c.kid JOIN m0_setting s ON s.smodule = 0 AND s.sgrup = 'akun' AND s.skode = 'HutangUsaha' AND t.tnorek = s.snilai JOIN m0_setting s2 ON s2.smodule = 0 AND s2.sgrup = 'accounting' AND s2.skode = 'MataUangFungsional'
```

```sql

```sql
select `ri`.`riid` AS `idtransaksi`,`ri`.`risumber` AS `sumber`,`ri`.`rinotransaksi` AS `notransaksi`,`ri`.`ritgl` AS `tgl`,`ri`.`risupplier` AS `kontak`,`ri`.`ricatatan` AS `catatan`,`ri`.`ricarabayar` AS `carabayar`,`ri`.`ritermin` AS `termin`,`ri`.`ritgljatuhtempo` AS `tgljatuhtempo`,`ri`.`rimatauang` AS `matauang`,`ri`.`rikurs` AS `kurs`,`ri`.`ritotaltransaksi` AS `totaltransaksi`,`ri`.`rijmlbayar` AS `terbayar`,(sum((`vppd`.`jmlbayar` - `vppd`.`jmlvp`)) / `ri`.`rikurs`) AS `rencana`,((`ri`.`ritotaltransaksi` - `ri`.`rijmlbayar`) * `ri`.`rikurs`) AS `sisa`,(case `ri`.`rimatauang` when `s2`.`snilai` then 0 else (`ri`.`ritotaltransaksi` - `ri`.`rijmlbayar`) end) AS `sisavalas`,`ri`.`ristatuslunas` AS `statuslunas`,`s`.`snilai` AS `rekhutangpiutang`,`tr`.`trdiskon1` AS `diskon1`,`tr`.`trharidiskon1` AS `haridiskon1`,`tr`.`trdiskon2` AS `diskon2`,`tr`.`trharidiskon2` AS `haridiskon2`,`ri`.`riinputtgl` AS `inputtgl` from ((((`m4_ri` `ri` left join `m1_terms` `tr` on((`ri`.`ritermin` = `tr`.`trkode`))) join `m0_setting` `s` on(((`s`.`smodule` = 0) and (`s`.`sgrup` = 'akun') and (`s`.`skode` = 'HutangUsaha')))) join `m0_setting` `s2` on(((`s2`.`smodule` = 0) and (`s2`.`sgrup` = 'accounting') and (`s2`.`skode` = 'MataUangFungsional')))) left join `m4_vpp_detail` `vppd` on(((`vppd`.`sumber` = 'RI') and (`vppd`.`idtransaksi` = `ri`.`riid`) and (`vppd`.`statusvp` <> 2)))) {filter1} group by `ri`.`riid`
```

```sql
select ri.riid AS idtransaksi, ri.risumber AS sumber, ri.rinotransaksi AS notransaksi,ri.ritgl AS tgl,ri.risupplier AS kontak,ri.ricatatan AS catatan,ri.ricarabayar AS carabayar,ri.ritermin AS termin,ri.ritgljatuhtempo AS tgljatuhtempo,ri.rimatauang AS matauang,ri.rikurs AS kurs,ri.ritotaltransaksi AS totaltransaksi,ri.rijmlbayar AS terbayar,(sum((vppd.jmlbayar - vppd.jmlvp)) / ri.rikurs) AS rencana,((ri.ritotaltransaksi - ri.rijmlbayar) * ri.rikurs) AS sisa,(case ri.rimatauang when s2.snilai then 0 else (ri.ritotaltransaksi - ri.rijmlbayar) end) AS sisavalas,ri.ristatuslunas AS statuslunas,s.snilai AS rekhutangpiutang,tr.trdiskon1 AS diskon1,tr.trharidiskon1 AS haridiskon1,tr.trdiskon2 AS diskon2,tr.trharidiskon2 AS haridiskon2,ri.riinputtgl AS inputtgl, ri.rinoref as noref from m4_ri ri join m1_contact c on ri.risupplier = c.kid join m0_setting s on s.smodule = 0 and s.sgrup = 'akun' and (case c.kcustomint1 when 0 then s.skode = 'HutangUsaha' else s.skode = 'HutangKonsinyasi' end) join m0_setting s2 on s2.smodule = 0 and s2.sgrup = 'accounting' and s2.skode = 'MataUangFungsional' left join m1_terms tr on ri.ritermin = tr.trkode left join m4_vpp_detail vppd on vppd.sumber = 'RI' and vppd.idtransaksi = ri.riid and vppd.statusvp <> 2 {filter1} group by ri.riid
```

```sql
select `ap`.`apid` AS `idtransaksi`,`ap`.`apsumber` AS `sumber`,`ap`.`apnotransaksi` AS `notransaksi`,`ap`.`aptgl` AS `tgl`,`ap`.`apkontak` AS `kontak`,`ap`.`apcatatan` AS `catatan`,0 AS `carabayar`,`ap`.`aptermin` AS `termin`,`ap`.`aptgljatuhtempo` AS `tgljatuhtempo`,`ap`.`apmatauang` AS `matauang`,`ap`.`apkurs` AS `kurs`,(case `ap`.`apmatauang` when `s2`.`snilai` then `ap`.`apjumlah` else `ap`.`apjumlahvalas` end) AS `totaltransaksi`,(case `ap`.`apmatauang` when `s2`.`snilai` then `ap`.`apjumlahbayar` else `ap`.`apjumlahbayarvalas` end) AS `terbayar`,(sum((`vppd`.`jmlbayar` - `vppd`.`jmlvp`)) / `ap`.`apkurs`) AS `rencana`,(`ap`.`apjumlah` - `ap`.`apjumlahbayar`) AS `sisa`,(case `ap`.`apmatauang` when `s2`.`snilai` then 0 else (`ap`.`apjumlahvalas` - `ap`.`apjumlahbayarvalas`) end) AS `sisavalas`,`ap`.`apstatusbayar` AS `statuslunas`,`ap`.`apnorek` AS `rekhutangpiutang`,`tr`.`trdiskon1` AS `diskon1`,`tr`.`trharidiskon1` AS `haridiskon1`,`tr`.`trdiskon2` AS `diskon2`,`tr`.`trharidiskon2` AS `haridiskon2`,`ap`.`apinputtgl` AS `inputtgl`, ap.apnoref as noref from (((`m4_ap` `ap` left join `m1_terms` `tr` on((`ap`.`aptermin` = `tr`.`trkode`))) join `m0_setting` `s2` on(((`s2`.`smodule` = 0) and (`s2`.`sgrup` = 'accounting') and (`s2`.`skode` = 'MataUangFungsional')))) left join `m4_vpp_detail` `vppd` on(((`vppd`.`sumber` = 'AP') and (`vppd`.`idtransaksi` = `ap`.`apid`) and (`vppd`.`statusvp` <> 2)))) {filter2} group by `ap`.`apid`
```

```sql
select lu.luid AS luid, lu.lucabang AS lucabang, lu.lulokasi AS lulokasi, lu.lugudang AS lugudang, lu.lusumber AS lusumber, lu.luautonotransaksi AS luautonotransaksi, lu.lunotransaksi AS lunotransaksi, lu.lutgl AS lutgl, lu.lukodepa AS lukodepa, lu.lucustomer AS lucustomer, lu.lucustomerkontak AS lucustomerkontak, lu.luuraian AS luuraian, lu.lucatatan AS lucatatan, lu.lunoref AS lunoref, lu.lutglnoref AS lutglnoref, lu.lutotaltransaksi AS lutotaltransaksi, lu.luidkj AS luidkj, lu.lustatusrealisasi AS lustatusrealisasi, lu.lustatus AS lustatus, lu.lustatussebelumnya AS lustatussebelumnya, lu.lujmlrevisi AS lujmlrevisi, lu.lucetakanke AS lucetakanke, lu.luinputuser AS luinputuser, lu.luinputtgl AS luinputtgl, lu.lumodifikasiuser AS lumodifikasiuser, lu.lumodifikasitgl AS lumodifikasitgl, lu.luisclose AS luisclose, br.bnama AS lucabangnama, lc.lnama AS lulokasinama, wh.wnama AS lugudangnama, c1.pkode AS lucustomerkode, (CASE lu.lucustomer WHEN 2 then k.knama ELSE c1.pnama END) AS lucustomernama, kj.kjnotransaksi AS lunotransaksikj, st1.nama AS lustatusnama, st2.nama AS lustatussebelumnyanama, u1.unama AS luinputusernama, u2.unama AS lumodifikasiusernama, lu.lupetugas, c2.kkode as lupetugaskode, c2.knama as lupetugasnama from m_11_lu lu left join m1_branch br on br.bkode = lu.lucabang left join m1_location lc on lc.lkode = lu.lulokasi left join m1_warehouse wh on wh.wkode = lu.lugudang left join m1_patient c1 on c1.pid = lu.lucustomer left join m_11_kj kj on lu.luidkj = kj.kjid left join m0_status st1 on st1.kode = lu.lustatus left join m0_status st2 on st2.kode = lu.lustatussebelumnya left join m0_user u1 on u1.userid = lu.luinputuser left join m0_user u2 on u2.userid = lu.lumodifikasiuser LEFT JOIN m1_contact k ON lu.lucustomer = k.kid LEFT JOIN m1_contact c2 ON lu.lupetugas = c2.kid

```sql
select `ak`.`akid` AS `akid`,`ak`.`akcabang` AS `akcabang`,`ak`.`aklokasi` AS `aklokasi`,`ak`.`akgudang` AS `akgudang`,`ak`.`aksumber` AS `aksumber`,`ak`.`akautonotransaksi` AS `akautonotransaksi`,`ak`.`aknotransaksi` AS `aknotransaksi`,`ak`.`aktgl` AS `aktgl`,`ak`.`akkodepa` AS `akkodepa`,`ak`.`akcustomer` AS `akcustomer`,`ak`.`akcustomerkontak` AS `akcustomerkontak`,`ak`.`akuraian` AS `akuraian`,`ak`.`akcatatan` AS `akcatatan`,`ak`.`aknoref` AS `aknoref`,`ak`.`aktglnoref` AS `aktglnoref`,`ak`.`aktotaltransaksi` AS `aktotaltransaksi`,`ak`.`akidkj` AS `akidkj`,`ak`.`akstatusrealisasi` AS `akstatusrealisasi`,`ak`.`akstatus` AS `akstatus`,`ak`.`akstatussebelumnya` AS `akstatussebelumnya`,`ak`.`akjmlrevisi` AS `akjmlrevisi`,`ak`.`akcetakanke` AS `akcetakanke`,`ak`.`akinputuser` AS `akinputuser`,`ak`.`akinputtgl` AS `akinputtgl`,`ak`.`akmodifikasiuser` AS `akmodifikasiuser`,`ak`.`akmodifikasitgl` AS `akmodifikasitgl`,`ak`.`akisclose` AS `akisclose`,`br`.`bnama` AS `akcabangnama`,`lc`.`lnama` AS `aklokasinama`,`wh`.`wnama` AS `akgudangnama`,`c1`.`kkode` AS `akcustomerkode`,`c1`.`knama` AS `akcustomernama`,`kj`.`kjnotransaksi` AS `aknotransaksikj`,`st1`.`nama` AS `akstatusnama`,`st2`.`nama` AS `akstatussebelumnyanama`,`u1`.`unama` AS `akinputusernama`,`u2`.`unama` AS `akmodifikasiusernama` from (((((((((`m_11_ak` `ak` left join `m1_branch` `br` on((`br`.`bkode` = `ak`.`akcabang`))) left join `m1_location` `lc` on((`lc`.`lkode` = `ak`.`aklokasi`))) left join `m1_warehouse` `wh` on((`wh`.`wkode` = `ak`.`akgudang`))) left join `m1_contact` `c1` on((`c1`.`kid` = `ak`.`akcustomer`)))left join `m_11_kj` `kj` on((`ak`.`akidkj` = `kj`.`kjid`))) left join `m0_status` `st1` on((`st1`.`kode` = `ak`.`akstatus`))) left join `m0_status` `st2` on((`st2`.`kode` = `ak`.`akstatussebelumnya`))) left join `m0_user` `u1` on((`u1`.`userid` = `ak`.`akinputuser`))) left join `m0_user` `u2` on((`u2`.`userid` = `ak`.`akmodifikasiuser`)))
```

```sql
select ak.akid AS akid, ak.akcabang AS akcabang, ak.aklokasi AS aklokasi, ak.akgudang AS akgudang, ak.aksumber AS aksumber, ak.akautonotransaksi AS akautonotransaksi, ak.aknotransaksi AS aknotransaksi, ak.aktgl AS aktgl, ak.akkodepa AS akkodepa, ak.akcustomer AS akcustomer, ak.akcustomerkontak AS akcustomerkontak, ak.akuraian AS akuraian, ak.akcatatan AS akcatatan, ak.aknoref AS aknoref, ak.aktglnoref AS aktglnoref, ak.aktotaltransaksi AS aktotaltransaksi, ak.akidkj AS akidkj, ak.akstatusrealisasi AS akstatusrealisasi, ak.akstatus AS akstatus, ak.akstatussebelumnya AS akstatussebelumnya, ak.akjmlrevisi AS akjmlrevisi, ak.akcetakanke AS akcetakanke, ak.akinputuser AS akinputuser, ak.akinputtgl AS akinputtgl, ak.akmodifikasiuser AS akmodifikasiuser, ak.akmodifikasitgl AS akmodifikasitgl, ak.akisclose AS akisclose, br.bnama AS akcabangnama, lc.lnama AS aklokasinama, wh.wnama AS akgudangnama, (CASE ak.akpenjualanlangsung WHEN 1 THEN c1.kkode ELSE p1.pkode END) AS akcustomerkode, (CASE ak.akpenjualanlangsung WHEN 1 THEN c1.knama ELSE p1.pnama END) AS akcustomernama, kj.kjnotransaksi AS aknotransaksikj, st1.nama AS akstatusnama, st2.nama AS akstatussebelumnyanama, u1.unama AS akinputusernama, u2.unama AS akmodifikasiusernama, IF(YEAR(ak.aktglbayar) > 2000,ak.aktglbayar,'') AS aktglbayar from m_11_ak ak left join m1_branch br on br.bkode = ak.akcabang left join m1_location lc on lc.lkode = ak.aklokasi left join m1_warehouse wh on wh.wkode = ak.akgudang left join m1_contact c1 on c1.kid = ak.akcustomer left join m1_patient p1 on ak.akcustomer = p1.pid left join m_11_kj kj on ak.akidkj = kj.kjid left join m0_status st1 on st1.kode = ak.akstatus left join m0_status st2 on st2.kode = ak.akstatussebelumnya left join m0_user u1 on u1.userid = ak.akinputuser left join m0_user u2 on u2.userid = ak.akmodifikasiuser
```

`coa2` on((`kw`.`kwrekdiskontermin` = `coa2`.`cnomor`))) left join `m0_status` `st1` on((`st1`.`kode` = `kw`.`kwstatus`))) left join `m0_status` `st2` on((`st2`.`kode` = `kw`.`kwstatussebelumnya`))) (`kwd`.`idtransaksi` = `kj`.`kjid`)))) left join `m_11_lu` `lu` on(((`kwd`.`sumber` = 'LU') and (`kwd`.`idtransaksi` = `lu`.`luid`)))) left join `m_11_ak` `ak` on(((`kwd`.`sumber` = 'AK') and (`kwd`.`idtransaksi` = `ak`.`akid`)))) left join `m_11_lb` `lb` on(((`kwd`.`sumber` = 'LB') and (`kwd`.`idtransaksi` = `lb`.`lbid`)))) left join `m1_coa` `coa3` on((`kwd`.`rekhutangpiutang` = `coa3`.`cnomor`))) left join `m1_cost_center` `cc` on((`kwd`.`costcenter` = `cc`.`cckode`))) left join `m1_division` `d` on((`kwd`.`divisi` = `d`.`dkode`))) left join `m2_giro_list` `gl` on((`kwd`.`nogiro` = `gl`.`glnogiro`))) left join `m1_project` `p` on((`kwd`.`proyek` = `p`.`pkode`))) left join `m1_subdivision` `sd` on((`kwd`.`subdivisi` = `sd`.`sdkode`))) left join `m1_contact` `kont` on((`kw`.`kwpetugas` = `kont`.`kid`))) left join `m1_contact` `dok` on((`kw`.`kwdokter` = `dok`.`kkode`)))

SELECT kj.kjid AS idtransaksi, kj.kjsumber AS sumber, kj.kjnotransaksi AS notransaksi, kj.kjtgl AS tgl, kj.kjnopasien AS norm, kj.kjnama AS nama, pc.pcnama AS kategoripasien, i.inama AS ditanggungoleh, kmr.rnama AS kamar, kj.kjalamat AS alamat, '' AS uraian, p.pid AS kontak, kj.kjcatatan AS catatan, (IFNULL(SUM(ak.aktotaltransaksi),0) + IFNULL(SUM(km.kmtotaltransaksi),0) + IFNULL(SUM(lb.lbtotaltransaksi),0) + IFNULL(SUM(lu.lutotaltransaksi),0) + IFNULL(SUM(rk.rkjumlah),0) - IFNULL(SUM(ro.rototaltransaksi),0) ) AS totaltransaksi, s.snilai AS rekhutangpiutang, kj.kjinputtgl AS inputtgl FROM (((((((((((m_11_kj AS kj LEFT JOIN m1_patient AS p ON ((kj.kjnopasien = p.pkode))) LEFT JOIN m_11_ak AS ak ON ((kj.kjid = ak.akidkj))) LEFT JOIN m_11_km AS km ON ((kj.kjid = km.kmidkj))) LEFT JOIN m_11_lb AS lb ON ((kj.kjid = lb.lbidkj))) LEFT JOIN m_11_lu AS lu ON ((kj.kjid = lu.luidkj))) LEFT JOIN m_11_rk AS rk ON ((kj.kjid = rk.rkidkj))) LEFT JOIN m_11_ro AS ro ON ((kj.kjid = ro.roidkj))) left join m0_setting s on(((s.smodule = 0) and (s.sgrup = 'akun') and (s.skode = 'PiutangUsaha')))) LEFT JOIN m1_patient_category AS pc ON ((kj.kjkategoripasien = pc.pckode))) LEFT JOIN m1_insurer AS i ON ((kj.kjditanggungoleh = i.iid))) LEFT JOIN m1_room AS kmr ON ((kj.kjkamar = kmr.rkode))){filter1} group by kj.kjid

```sql
SELECT a.*, u.unama AS blinputusernama, u2.unama AS blmodifikasiusernama, b.scnama AS blkategorisiswanama FROM m13_bl a LEFT JOIN m0_user u ON (a.blinputuser = u.userid) LEFT JOIN m0_user u2 ON (a.blmodifikasiuser = u2.userid) LEFT JOIN m13_student_category b ON (a.blkategorisiswa = b.scid)
```

```sql
SELECT a.*, sc.sckode AS blkategorisiswakode, sc.scnama AS blkategorisiswanama, b.*, u.unama AS blinputusernama, u2.unama AS blmodifikasiusernama, s.nama AS blstatusnama, s2.nama AS blstatussebelumnyanama FROM m13_bl a JOIN m13_bl_detail b ON (a.blid = b.idbl) LEFT JOIN m0_user u ON (a.blinputuser = u.userid) LEFT JOIN m0_user u2 ON (a.blmodifikasiuser = u2.userid) LEFT JOIN m0_status s ON (a.blstatus = s.kode) LEFT JOIN m0_status s2 ON (a.blstatussebelumnya = s2.kode) LEFT JOIN m13_student_category sc ON (a.blkategorisiswa = sc.scid)
```

```sql
SELECT a.*, u.unama AS pyinputusernama, u2.unama AS pymodifikasiusernama, sc.scnama AS pykategorisiswanama, s.nama AS pystatusnama, SUM(b.bayar) AS pytotaltransaksi FROM m13_py a LEFT JOIN m13_py_detail b ON (a.pyid = b.idpy) LEFT JOIN m0_user u ON (a.pyinputuser = u.userid) LEFT JOIN m0_user u2 ON (a.pymodifikasiuser = u2.userid) LEFT JOIN m13_student_category sc ON (a.pykategorisiswa = sc.scid) LEFT JOIN m0_status s ON (a.pystatus = s.kode)
```

```sql
SELECT a.*, sc.sckode AS pykategorisiswakode, sc.scnama AS pykategorisiswanama, b.*, u.unama AS pyinputusernama, u2.unama AS pymodifikasiusernama, s.nama AS pystatusnama, s2.nama AS pystatussebelumnyanama, c.bcnama AS pykategoribillingnama FROM m13_py a JOIN m13_py_detail b ON (a.pyid = b.idpy) LEFT JOIN m0_user u ON (a.pyinputuser = u.userid) LEFT JOIN m0_user u2 ON (a.pymodifikasiuser = u2.userid) LEFT JOIN m0_status s ON (a.pystatus = s.kode) LEFT JOIN m0_status s2 ON (a.pystatussebelumnya = s2.kode) LEFT JOIN m13_student_category sc ON (a.pykategorisiswa = sc.scid) LEFT JOIN m13_billing_category c ON (a.pykategoribilling = c.bckode)
```

```sql
SELECT a.*, c.nama AS carabayarnama FROM m13_py_detail_bayar a JOIN m13_py b ON (a.idpy = b.pyid) LEFT JOIN m0_payment_method c ON (a.carabayar = c.kode)
```

```sql
SELECT a.*, u.unama AS smpinputusernama, u2.unama AS smpmodifikasiusernama, s.nama AS smpstatusnama, SUM(b.jumlah) AS smptotaltransaksi FROM m14_smp a LEFT JOIN m14_smp_detail b ON (a.smpid = b.idsmp) LEFT JOIN m0_user u ON (a.smpinputuser = u.userid) LEFT JOIN m0_user u2 ON (a.smpmodifikasiuser = u2.userid) LEFT JOIN m0_status s ON (a.smpstatus = s.kode)
```

```sql
SELECT a.*, b.*, u.unama AS smpinputusernama, u2.unama AS smpmodifikasiusernama, s.nama AS smpstatusnama, s2.nama AS smpstatussebelumnyanama FROM m14_smp a JOIN m14_smp_detail b ON (a.smpid = b.idsmp) LEFT JOIN m0_user u ON (a.smpinputuser = u.userid) LEFT JOIN m0_user u2 ON (a.smpmodifikasiuser = u2.userid) LEFT JOIN m0_status s ON (a.smpstatus = s.kode) LEFT JOIN m0_status s2 ON (a.smpstatussebelumnya = s2.kode)
```

```sql
SELECT a.*, c.nama AS carabayarnama FROM m14_smp_detail_bayar a JOIN m14_smp b ON (a.idsmp = b.smpid) LEFT JOIN m0_payment_method c ON (a.carabayar = c.kode)
```

```sql
SELECT r.rid, r.rmoduleid, o.mname AS rmodulename, r.rmenuid, m.mnname AS rmenuname, IFNULL(r2.ritem,0) AS ritem, IFNULL(r2.rreportname,'') AS rreportname FROM `m0_report` r JOIN m0_module o ON o.mid = r.rmoduleid JOIN m0_menu_s m ON r.rmoduleid = m.mnmoduleid AND r.rmenuid = m.mnid LEFT JOIN (SELECT sr.rmoduleid, sr.rmenuid, sr.rid, sr.rdefault, sr.ritem, sr.rreportname FROM m0_report sr WHERE sr.raktif = 1 AND sr.rdefault = 1) AS r2 ON r2.rmoduleid = r.rmoduleid AND r2.rmenuid = r.rmenuid
```

```sql

```sql
SELECT '{FixQuotes_idLogin}' as idlogin, 1 as glnourut, 0 as glid, 0 as glkontak, '' as glkontakkode, '' as glkontaknama, '{FixQuotes_tglAwal}' as gltgl, '' as glnotransaksi, '{FixQuotes_currNorek}' as glnorek, coa.cnama as glnoreknama, '{FixQuotes_matauang}' as glmatauang, 0 as glkurs, 'Saldo Awal' as gluraian, 'Saldo Awal' as glcatatan, (CASE LENGTH('{FixQuotes_matauang}') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE (CASE '{FixQuotes_matauang}' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) END)as gldebit, (CASE LENGTH('{FixQuotes_matauang}') WHEN 0 THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE (CASE '{FixQuotes_matauang}' WHEN s.snilai THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) END) END) as glkredit, (CASE LENGTH('{FixQuotes_matauang}') WHEN 0 THEN (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0)-IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0)-IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) ELSE (CASE '{FixQuotes_matauang}' WHEN s.snilai THEN (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0)-IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkredit),0)-IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebit),0) END) ELSE (CASE coa.cdc WHEN 'D' THEN IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0)-IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0) ELSE IFNULL(SUM(t.tkreditvalas),0)-IFNULL(SUM(t.tdebitvalas),0) END) END) END) as glsaldo, CONCAT('{FixQuotes_tglAwal}',' SELECT sad.idsadetail, sad.idbarang, sad.namabarang, sad.tipebarang, (CASE j.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN isw.stok / sad.nilaisatuan ELSE 0 END) as jmlmasuk, (CASE j.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN isw.stok / sad.nilaisatuan ELSE 0 END) as jmlkeluar, sad.satuan, sad.nilaisatuan, (CASE j.jenismutasi WHEN 1 THEN isw.stok ELSE 0 END) as jmlbarangmasuk, (CASE j.jenismutasi WHEN 0 THEN isw.stok ELSE 0 END) as jmlbarangkeluar, sad.satuanbarang, sad.hpp, sad.idhppkhususmasuk, isw.kgudang as gudang, sad.catatan, sad.costcenter, sad.divisi, sad.subdivisi, sad.customdbl1, sad.proyek, sa.sainputtgl, i.bhpp FROM m3_sa_detail sad JOIN m3_sa sa ON sad.idsa = sa.said JOIN m1_item i ON sad.idbarang = i.bid JOIN m0_jenismutasi j JOIN m1_item_stock_warehouse isw ON sad.idbarang = isw.idbarang AND isw.stok <> 0 WHERE sad.idsa = '{result_4}' AND sad.idsadetail = '{iddetail}' ORDER BY sad.idsadetail, j.jenismutasi, isw.kgudang
